isolation.weilan_method_home: fresh isolated per trial; case 7 may seed from its fixture method-state snapshot
isolation.live_source_reads: forbidden unless the case fixture explicitly contains the source snapshot
isolation.network_or_external_api: forbidden unless a future approved shadow plan explicitly allows it

runner_boundary: finite foreground manifest only; no daemon, heartbeat, wakeup, polling loop, self-scheduled continuation, adoption, or deployment

trial_receipt_requirements.method_impact: candidate receipts must report observable Method Impact Trace records; hidden reasoning is forbidden

model_tool_config_policy: A future shadow plan must bind the exact model/tool/runtime identifiers and use the same configuration for baseline and candidate. This suite-level config fixes isolation and artifact boundaries.
